headline: アルカリホスファターゼとプロテイナーゼKが、繊維を作る
subhead: クライオ電顕で、緑膿菌ALPのフィラメントとProtKのナノチューブの構造を決めた

summary.question: 酵素が繊維になって活性を調節する例は知られるが、よく使う2つの酵素の重合は報告がなかった。
summary.approach: 細菌試料のクライオ電顕像に写った未知の繊維を、再構成とモデル構築で同定した。
summary.result: 緑膿菌ALPの二量体がらせん状に並ぶ繊維（約3.7 Å）と、ProtKの中空ナノチューブ（3.2 Å）が見つかった。
summary.learned: ALPの繊維は未同定の密度が足場らしく、ProtKの管は濃度による詰まりと整合する。
summary.open: 生理的な意義は不明で、活性への影響は今後の実験が必要だ。

question.quote: Filamentation has been abundantly documented to be responsible for either enzyme activation (6) or repression (7), and thus the polymeric state of an enzyme can provide a new level of biological regulation.
we have serendipitously discovered a previously unreported filamentation of two commonly used enzymes in molecular microbiology: alkaline phosphatase (ALP) and proteinase K (ProtK).

approach.quote: To overcome this problem, we employed asymmetric reconstruction by relaxing symmetry constraints, a strategy successfully leveraged in prior challenging filament studies (9).
allowing for automated de novo model building using ModelAngelo (15), which identified the subunit as proteinase K

result.quote: This approach substantially improved the map, yielding a ~3.7 Å resolution density map that enabled unambiguous atomic model building and identified the filament-forming protein as ALP
These micrographs revealed the presence of 17 nm diameter nanotubes of unknown composition (Fig. 2A and B).

learned.quote: However, the true structural anchors appear to be the unassigned central and peripheral densities.
Such minimal interfaces are more consistent with a concentration-driven packing than with a cooperatively regulated polymer.

open.quote: While the physiological significance of fibrillation in alkaline phosphatase and proteinase K is unknown,

Distinguishing an evolved function from an incidental property of a sticky, hyperstable enzyme will require direct tests of concentration dependence and of catalytic activity in the polymeric versus monomeric state.

highlights.text: ALP の二量体は 1 個ごとに 28.4 Å 進み 83.2° ねじれて並び、らせんになる。軸の中心と外周には、タンパク質ではない正体不明の密度が走る。

evidence.quote: Tilted at ~40° relative to the central filament axis, these ALP dimers assemble into a 1-start helix with a rise of 28.4 Å and a twist of 83.2° per dimer.
the map revealed two striking, unassigned densities: one running directly down the central axis of the filament and another wrapping along the outer periphery (Fig. 1C).

highlights.text: 密度に接する ALP の表面は正に帯電し、39-KKK-41 や R219・R248 が接する。大腸菌 ALP にこれらの残基はない。著者は、密度の正体を負電荷の分子（DNA や多糖など）と考えている。

evidence.quote: The 39-KKK-41 motif surrounds the central axis density, while residues R219 and R248 contact the peripheral density (Fig. 1F).
Intriguingly, these positively charged residues are completely absent in the homologous periplasmic E. coli ALP (UniProt P00634), which shares 74% sequence identity (Fig. 1G).
Such concentrated electropositive tracks indicate that these unknown densities represent negatively charged biomolecules

highlights.text: ProtK は 8 本のプロトフィラメントが逆向きに並び、外径約 170 Å・内径約 90 Å の管になる。単量体は既存の結晶構造とほぼ同じで、活性部位は管の外に開いている。

evidence.quote: The hollow tubes (with an inner diameter of ~90 Å) are composed of eight ProtK protofilaments that run in an antiparallel fashion as a result of the global dihedral (D1) symmetry (Fig. 2E and F).
The structural overlay between 3PRK and our model (Fig. 2G) shows that the active site of ProtK is solvent accessible in the nanotube assembly (Fig. 2D through F).
Outer diameter: ~170 Å, inner diameter: ~90 Å.

lab_notes.sample_prep: ALP はリン酸制限下で育てた緑膿菌の細胞外の剪断試料、ProtK は市販品で分解したケーブル細菌の細胞壁（サッキュラス）の試料。
lab_notes.data_collection: ALP は対称性を課さない再構成（約3.7 Å）、二量体は C2 で局所精製（約3.3 Å）。ProtK はらせんパラメータ rise 8.36 Å・twist −83.72°（3.2 Å）で、ModelAngelo で自動構築。

evidence.quote: Cryo-EM micrographs of an extracellular sheared sample from Pseudomonas aeruginosa grown under phosphate-limiting conditions revealed filaments of unknown identity
we collected cryo-EM data on ProtK (commercial source: cat. no. 124568, Merck/Sigma-Aldrich) digested sacculi of the cable bacterium Electrothrix gigas.
Local refinement focused on a single ALP dimer with imposed C2 symmetry improved the resolution to ~3.3 Å, providing additional confirmation of the ALP assignment.
Standard helical processing was used to refine the rise and twist to 8.36 Å and −83.72° and yielded a 3.2 Å reconstruction (Fig. 2C)

keywords: アルカリホスファターゼ
editor_notes: ALP（Q02QC9）は PDB にそれまで構造がなく first_structure=true。ただし論文は『初構造』とは書かず、重合が未報告と述べている。ProtK は既存の結晶構造が多数ある別状態（ナノチューブ）。PDB の引用は『To be provided later』で、2 エントリは deposition statement から対応づけた。Methods は補足資料で、packet にない。ProtK ナノチューブは濃度によるアーティファクトの可能性を著者自身が述べている。
